description: Multi-Match Scheduler (Task 14): create POST bulk match generation route with 4 ScheduledJob records per match in one transaction, PATCH reschedule route with cascade cancel/recreate and overlap detection, admin MatchScheduler client component, and admin matches page. Depends on FEAT-001 (assertMatchTransition).
steps: Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/matches/bulk/route.ts. Export POST = withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER, async (req, { guildId, userId, params }) => { ... }). Body schema: z.array(z.object({ stageId: z.string().cuid(), number: z.number().int().positive(), scheduledStart: z.string().datetime(), scheduledEnd: z.string().datetime(), map: z.string().optional(), mode: z.string().optional(), matchSpecificRules: z.string().optional() })).min(1).max(50). Validate tournament belongs to guildId. Validate each stageId belongs to this tournament: prisma.stage.findFirst({ where: { id: stageId, tournamentId } }). Inside prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => { const matches = []; for each item: const match = await tx.match.create({ data: { stageId, guildId, number, scheduledStart: new Date(item.scheduledStart), scheduledEnd: new Date(item.scheduledEnd), map, mode, matchSpecificRules, status: 'SCHEDULED' } }); matches.push(match); const start = new Date(item.scheduledStart); const end = new Date(item.scheduledEnd); const jobBase = 'match:' + match.id; await tx.scheduledJob.createMany({ data: [ { jobKey: jobBase + ':REMINDER_24H', type: 'MATCH_REMINDER', payloadJson: { matchId: match.id, type: 'REMINDER_24H' }, scheduledFor: new Date(start.getTime() - 24*60*60*1000), matchId: match.id, tournamentId: params.tournamentId }, { jobKey: jobBase + ':REMINDER_30M', type: 'MATCH_REMINDER', payloadJson: { matchId: match.id, type: 'REMINDER_30M' }, scheduledFor: new Date(start.getTime() - 30*60*1000), matchId: match.id, tournamentId: params.tournamentId }, { jobKey: jobBase + ':ROOM_RELEASE', type: 'ROOM_RELEASE', payloadJson: { matchId: match.id }, scheduledFor: new Date(start.getTime() - 10*60*1000), matchId: match.id, tournamentId: params.tournamentId }, { jobKey: jobBase + ':RESULT_DEADLINE', type: 'RESULT_DEADLINE', payloadJson: { matchId: match.id }, scheduledFor: new Date(end.getTime() + 2*60*60*1000), matchId: match.id, tournamentId: params.tournamentId } ] }); } await tx.outboxEvent.create({ data: { guildId, type: 'MATCHES_SCHEDULED', payloadJson: { tournamentId: params.tournamentId, matchIds: matches.map(m => m.id), count: matches.length }, status: 'PENDING' } }); return matches; }). Return 201 { matches }.

Create apps/web/src/app/api/servers/[guildId]/matches/[matchId]/schedule/route.ts. Export PATCH = withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER, async (req, { guildId, userId, params }) => { ... }). Body schema: z.object({ scheduledStart: z.string().datetime(), scheduledEnd: z.string().datetime(), reason: z.string().max(500).optional() }). Fetch match: prisma.match.findFirst({ where: { id: params.matchId, guildId }, select: { id, status, stageId, stage: { select: { tournamentId } } } }) — 404 if missing. Import assertMatchTransition from @esports/tournament-engine. Call assertMatchTransition(match.status, 'SCHEDULED') — if throws return 409 { error: error.message }. Overlap detection: const overlapping = await prisma.match.count({ where: { guildId, id: { not: matchId }, scheduledStart: { lt: new Date(scheduledEnd) }, scheduledEnd: { gt: new Date(scheduledStart) } } }); if overlapping > 0 return 409 { error: 'schedule_overlap', message: 'Another match is scheduled during this time window' }. Inside prisma.$transaction: prisma.match.update({ where: { id: matchId }, data: { scheduledStart: new Date(scheduledStart), scheduledEnd: new Date(scheduledEnd), status: 'SCHEDULED' } }); prisma.scheduledJob.updateMany({ where: { matchId, status: 'PENDING' }, data: { status: 'CANCELLED', cancelledAt: new Date() } }); const jobBase = 'match:' + matchId + ':reschedule:' + Date.now(); create 4 new ScheduledJob rows with new times (same pattern as bulk route but suffix jobKey with ':v2' or timestamp to avoid unique constraint collision); create AuditLog { action: 'MATCH_RESCHEDULED', targetType: 'Match', targetId: matchId, reason, metadata: { previousStart, previousEnd, newStart: scheduledStart, newEnd: scheduledEnd } }; create OutboxEvent { type: 'MATCH_RESCHEDULED', guildId, payloadJson: { matchId, scheduledStart, scheduledEnd, reason } }. Return 200 { match: updated }.

Create apps/web/src/components/admin/MatchScheduler.tsx. 'use client' component. Props: { guildId: string; tournamentId: string; stages: StageWithMatches[] } where StageWithMatches = { id, name, matches: { id, number, status, scheduledStart, scheduledEnd, map, mode }[] }. State: bulkModalOpen (boolean), rescheduleTarget (match | null). Render a table of all matches across stages using @tanstack/react-table: columns = Stage, Match #, Status (Badge), Scheduled Start (formatted), Map, Mode, Actions. Actions cell: Reschedule button (disabled if match.status not in ['SCHEDULED','POSTPONED']). Header: 'Bulk Create Matches' button (GlowButton) opens the bulk modal. Bulk modal (Radix Dialog): a dynamic form to add 1–10 match rows. Each row: stageId (Radix Select populated from stages prop), number (number input), scheduledStart/scheduledEnd (datetime-local inputs), map (text), mode (text). Submit calls POST /api/servers/${guildId}/tournaments/${tournamentId}/matches/bulk, shows toast on success, closes modal, triggers page refresh via router.refresh(). Reschedule modal (Radix Dialog): pre-fill scheduledStart/scheduledEnd from target match, show reason textarea, submit calls PATCH /api/servers/${guildId}/matches/${target.id}/schedule, shows toast, closes modal, refreshes. Follow GlassCard, GlowButton, Badge patterns from existing components.

Create apps/web/src/app/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId]/matches/page.tsx. Server component. Auth + TOURNAMENT_MANAGER guard (same pattern as participants/page.tsx). Fetch prisma.tournament.findFirst({ where: { id: params.tournamentId, guildId: params.guildId }, include: { stages: { orderBy: { order: 'asc' }, include: { matches: { orderBy: { number: 'asc' }, select: { id, number, status, scheduledStart, scheduledEnd, map, mode } } } } } }). Serialize Date fields. Return <MatchScheduler guildId={...} tournamentId={...} stages={serialized} />.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm --filter web type-check exits with code 0
POST bulk route creates exactly 4 ScheduledJob rows per match
PATCH schedule route returns 409 when match status is COMPLETED
PATCH schedule route returns 409 on time overlap with another match in the same guild
Admin matches page renders MatchScheduler client component
